--- file:///.src/resultMatchToFromResult_shapes.ts ---
// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics resultMatchToFromResult:suggestion
import { Effect, pipe, Result } from "effect"
import { match as matchResult } from "effect/Result"

declare const result: Result.Result<number, Error>
declare const parsePort: (raw: string) => Result.Result<number, Error>
const matchAlias = Result.match
const onFailure = Effect.fail
const onSuccess = Effect.succeed

// MUST TRIGGER: a pipeable Result.match inside a longer pipe chain is replaced in place.
export const pipeChain = result.pipe(
  Effect.fromResult,
  (effect: Effect.Effect<number, Error>) => effect
)

// MUST TRIGGER: Result.match inside an Effect.fn generator body.
export const insideEffectFn = Effect.fn("parse")(function*(raw: string) {
  return yield* Result.match(parsePort(raw), { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })
})

// MUST TRIGGER: Result.match inside an Effect.fnUntraced generator body.
export const insideEffectFnUntraced = Effect.fnUntraced(function*(raw: string) {
  return yield* Result.match(parsePort(raw), { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })
})

// MUST TRIGGER: Result.match passed as a later data-first value argument roots its own flow.
export const dataFirstValueArgument = Effect.andThen(
  Effect.void,
  Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })
)

// MUST TRIGGER: match imported by name from the effect/Result subpath.
export const namedImport = matchResult(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })

// MUST TRIGGER: a local const alias of Result.match.
export const constAlias = matchAlias(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })

// MUST TRIGGER: parentheses around the handlers object and the handlers.
export const parenthesizedHandlers = Result.match(result, ({
  onFailure: (Effect.fail),
  onSuccess: ((value) => Effect.succeed(value))
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: annotated handler parameters are still identity lifts.
export const annotatedHandlers = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: (error: Error) => Effect.fail(error),
  onSuccess: (value: number) => Effect.succeed(value)
})

// MUST TRIGGER: handlers whose returned flow pipes the parameter into the lift.
export const pipedHandlers = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: (error) => pipe(error, Effect.fail),
  onSuccess: (value) => pipe(value, Effect.succeed)
})

// MUST TRIGGER: parentheses around the guard ternary branches and the tested Result.
export const parenthesizedTernary = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? (Effect.succeed((result).success))
  : (Effect.fail(result.failure))

// MUST TRIGGER: guard ternary branches written as pipe flows.
export const pipedTernaryBranches = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? pipe(result.success, Effect.succeed)
  : pipe(result.failure, Effect.fail)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the next-line directive turns the rule off for this match only.
// @effect-diagnostics-next-line resultMatchToFromResult:off
export const disabledByDirective = Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: shorthand handler properties.
export const shorthand = Result.match(result, { onFailure, onSuccess })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: method handlers.
export const methodHandlers = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure(error) {
    return Effect.fail(error)
  },
  onSuccess(value) {
    return Effect.succeed(value)
  }
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a spread handler.
export const spreadHandler = Result.match(result, { ...{ onFailure: Effect.fail }, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: an extra property next to the handlers.
export const extraProperty = Result.match(
  result,
  { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed, extra: 1 } as {
    onFailure: typeof Effect.fail
    onSuccess: typeof Effect.succeed
  }
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a duplicate handler property.
export const duplicateHandler = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: Effect.succeed,
  // @ts-expect-error duplicate property
  onSuccess: Effect.succeed
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a generator handler returns a generator, not the lifted Effect.
export const generatorHandler = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: function*(value) {
    return Effect.succeed(value)
  }
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter value.
export const defaultParameter = Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: (value = 1) => Effect.succeed(value) })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a rest parameter.
export const restParameter = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: (...values: Array<number>) => Effect.succeed(values[0])
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a statement before the returned lift.
export const extraStatement = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: (value) => {
    void value
    return Effect.succeed(value)
  }
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: an instantiation expression pins the success type.
export const instantiationExpression = Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed<number> })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: explicit type arguments on Result.match.
export const matchTypeArguments = Result.match<number, Error, Effect.Effect<never, Error>, Effect.Effect<number>>(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: Effect.succeed
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a handler flow that keeps going after the lift.
export const longerHandlerFlow = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: (value) => pipe(value, Effect.succeed, Effect.asVoid)
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a cast around a branch.
export const castBranch = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? (Effect.succeed(result.success) as Effect.Effect<number, Error>)
  : Effect.fail(result.failure)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a chained ternary has a third outcome.
export const chainedTernary = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? Effect.succeed(result.success)
  : Result.isFailure(result)
  ? Effect.fail(result.failure)
  : Effect.die("unreachable")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: an optional chain in a branch.
export const optionalChain = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? Effect.succeed(result?.success)
  : Effect.fail(result.failure)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a _tag comparison is not a Result guard.
export const tagTernary = result._tag === "Success"
  ? Effect.succeed(result.success)
  : Effect.fail(result.failure)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a negated guard.
export const negatedGuard = !Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? Effect.fail(result.failure)
  : Effect.succeed(result.success)

export const annotatedHandlers = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: (error: Error) => Effect.fail(error),
  onSuccess: (value: number) => Effect.succeed(value)
})

// MUST TRIGGER: handlers whose returned flow pipes the parameter into the lift.
export const pipedHandlers = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: (error) => pipe(error, Effect.fail),
  onSuccess: (value) => pipe(value, Effect.succeed)
})

// MUST TRIGGER: parentheses around the guard ternary branches and the tested Result.
export const parenthesizedTernary = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? (Effect.succeed((result).success))
  : (Effect.fail(result.failure))

// MUST TRIGGER: guard ternary branches written as pipe flows.
export const pipedTernaryBranches = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? pipe(result.success, Effect.succeed)
  : pipe(result.failure, Effect.fail)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the next-line directive turns the rule off for this match only.
// @effect-diagnostics-next-line resultMatchToFromResult:off
export const disabledByDirective = Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: shorthand handler properties.
export const shorthand = Result.match(result, { onFailure, onSuccess })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: method handlers.
export const methodHandlers = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure(error) {
    return Effect.fail(error)
  },
  onSuccess(value) {
    return Effect.succeed(value)
  }
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a spread handler.
export const spreadHandler = Result.match(result, { ...{ onFailure: Effect.fail }, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: an extra property next to the handlers.
export const extraProperty = Result.match(
  result,
  { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed, extra: 1 } as {
    onFailure: typeof Effect.fail
    onSuccess: typeof Effect.succeed
  }
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a duplicate handler property.
export const duplicateHandler = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: Effect.succeed,
  // @ts-expect-error duplicate property
  onSuccess: Effect.succeed
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a generator handler returns a generator, not the lifted Effect.
export const generatorHandler = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: function*(value) {
    return Effect.succeed(value)
  }
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter value.
export const defaultParameter = Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: (value = 1) => Effect.succeed(value) })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a rest parameter.
export const restParameter = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: (...values: Array<number>) => Effect.succeed(values[0])
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a statement before the returned lift.
export const extraStatement = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: (value) => {
    void value
    return Effect.succeed(value)
  }
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: an instantiation expression pins the success type.
export const instantiationExpression = Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed<number> })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: explicit type arguments on Result.match.
export const matchTypeArguments = Result.match<number, Error, Effect.Effect<never, Error>, Effect.Effect<number>>(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: Effect.succeed
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a handler flow that keeps going after the lift.
export const longerHandlerFlow = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: (value) => pipe(value, Effect.succeed, Effect.asVoid)
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a cast around a branch.
export const castBranch = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? (Effect.succeed(result.success) as Effect.Effect<number, Error>)
  : Effect.fail(result.failure)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a chained ternary has a third outcome.
export const chainedTernary = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? Effect.succeed(result.success)
  : Result.isFailure(result)
  ? Effect.fail(result.failure)
  : Effect.die("unreachable")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: an optional chain in a branch.
export const optionalChain = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? Effect.succeed(result?.success)
  : Effect.fail(result.failure)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a _tag comparison is not a Result guard.
export const tagTernary = result._tag === "Success"
  ? Effect.succeed(result.success)
  : Effect.fail(result.failure)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a negated guard.
export const negatedGuard = !Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? Effect.fail(result.failure)
  : Effect.succeed(result.success)

// @effect-diagnostics *:off
// @effect-diagnostics resultMatchToFromResult:suggestion
import { Effect, pipe, Result } from "effect"
import { match as matchResult } from "effect/Result"

declare const result: Result.Result<number, Error>
declare const parsePort: (raw: string) => Result.Result<number, Error>
const matchAlias = Result.match
const onFailure = Effect.fail
const onSuccess = Effect.succeed

// MUST TRIGGER: a pipeable Result.match inside a longer pipe chain is replaced in place.
export const pipeChain = result.pipe(
  Result.match({ onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed }),
  (effect: Effect.Effect<number, Error>) => effect
)

// MUST TRIGGER: Result.match inside an Effect.fn generator body.
export const insideEffectFn = Effect.fn("parse")(function*(raw: string) {
  return yield* Result.match(parsePort(raw), { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })
})

// MUST TRIGGER: Result.match inside an Effect.fnUntraced generator body.
export const insideEffectFnUntraced = Effect.fnUntraced(function*(raw: string) {
  return yield* Result.match(parsePort(raw), { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })
})

// MUST TRIGGER: Result.match passed as a later data-first value argument roots its own flow.
export const dataFirstValueArgument = Effect.andThen(
  Effect.void,
  Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })
)

// MUST TRIGGER: match imported by name from the effect/Result subpath.
export const namedImport = Effect.fromResult(result)

// MUST TRIGGER: a local const alias of Result.match.
export const constAlias = matchAlias(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })

// MUST TRIGGER: parentheses around the handlers object and the handlers.
export const parenthesizedHandlers = Result.match(result, ({
  onFailure: (Effect.fail),
  onSuccess: ((value) => Effect.succeed(value))
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: annotated handler parameters are still identity lifts.

// MUST TRIGGER: Result.match passed as a later data-first value argument roots its own flow.
export const dataFirstValueArgument = Effect.andThen(
  Effect.void,
  Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })
)

// MUST TRIGGER: match imported by name from the effect/Result subpath.
export const namedImport = matchResult(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })

// MUST TRIGGER: a local const alias of Result.match.
export const constAlias = matchAlias(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })

// MUST TRIGGER: parentheses around the handlers object and the handlers.
export const parenthesizedHandlers = Result.match(result, ({
  onFailure: (Effect.fail),
  onSuccess: ((value) => Effect.succeed(value))
}))

// MUST TRIGGER: annotated handler parameters are still identity lifts.
export const annotatedHandlers = Effect.fromResult(result)

// MUST TRIGGER: handlers whose returned flow pipes the parameter into the lift.
export const pipedHandlers = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: (error) => pipe(error, Effect.fail),
  onSuccess: (value) => pipe(value, Effect.succeed)
})

// MUST TRIGGER: parentheses around the guard ternary branches and the tested Result.
export const parenthesizedTernary = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? (Effect.succeed((result).success))
  : (Effect.fail(result.failure))

// MUST TRIGGER: guard ternary branches written as pipe flows.
export const pipedTernaryBranches = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? pipe(result.success, Effect.succeed)
  : pipe(result.failure, Effect.fail)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: the next-line directive turns the rule off for this match only.
// @effect-diagnostics-next-line resultMatchToFromResult:off
export const disabledByDirective = Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: shorthand handler properties.
export const shorthand = Result.match(result, { onFailure, onSuccess })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: method handlers.
export const methodHandlers = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure(error) {
    return Effect.fail(error)
  },
  onSuccess(value) {
    return Effect.succeed(value)
  }
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a spread handler.
export const spreadHandler = Result.match(result, { ...{ onFailure: Effect.fail }, onSuccess: Effect.succeed })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: an extra property next to the handlers.
export const extraProperty = Result.match(
  result,
  { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed, extra: 1 } as {
    onFailure: typeof Effect.fail
    onSuccess: typeof Effect.succeed
  }
)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a duplicate handler property.
export const duplicateHandler = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: Effect.succeed,
  // @ts-expect-error duplicate property
  onSuccess: Effect.succeed
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a generator handler returns a generator, not the lifted Effect.
export const generatorHandler = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: function*(value) {
    return Effect.succeed(value)
  }
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a default parameter value.
export const defaultParameter = Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: (value = 1) => Effect.succeed(value) })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a rest parameter.
export const restParameter = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: (...values: Array<number>) => Effect.succeed(values[0])
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a statement before the returned lift.
export const extraStatement = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: (value) => {
    void value
    return Effect.succeed(value)
  }
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: an instantiation expression pins the success type.
export const instantiationExpression = Result.match(result, { onFailure: Effect.fail, onSuccess: Effect.succeed<number> })

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: explicit type arguments on Result.match.
export const matchTypeArguments = Result.match<number, Error, Effect.Effect<never, Error>, Effect.Effect<number>>(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: Effect.succeed
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a handler flow that keeps going after the lift.
export const longerHandlerFlow = Result.match(result, {
  onFailure: Effect.fail,
  onSuccess: (value) => pipe(value, Effect.succeed, Effect.asVoid)
})

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a cast around a branch.
export const castBranch = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? (Effect.succeed(result.success) as Effect.Effect<number, Error>)
  : Effect.fail(result.failure)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a chained ternary has a third outcome.
export const chainedTernary = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? Effect.succeed(result.success)
  : Result.isFailure(result)
  ? Effect.fail(result.failure)
  : Effect.die("unreachable")

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: an optional chain in a branch.
export const optionalChain = Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? Effect.succeed(result?.success)
  : Effect.fail(result.failure)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a _tag comparison is not a Result guard.
export const tagTernary = result._tag === "Success"
  ? Effect.succeed(result.success)
  : Effect.fail(result.failure)

// MUST NOT TRIGGER: a negated guard.
export const negatedGuard = !Result.isSuccess(result)
  ? Effect.fail(result.failure)
  : Effect.succeed(result.success)
